papers.title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly perform knowledge work (i.e., produce and modify persistent digital artifacts such as code repositories, documents, spreadsheets, slides, reports), yet the parsed views they search, the native files they edit, the changes they review, and the artifacts they submit can refer to different versions of the same work product. We formulate this as a workspace-state contract: every view should be explicitly tied to a version of the evolving workspace state. Coding agents partly address this need through repository contracts for search, diffs, and tests, whereas an analogous contract is less explicit for PDFs, spreadsheets, slides, notebooks, and mixed-format project folders. We propose StagedWorkspace, a versioned workspace for knowledge-work agents. The workspace binds parsed records and review diffs to content hashes of the native files as they change. In fixed-harness ablations on OfficeQA Pro and APEX-Agents, dual parsed/native access has the highest point estimate for every tested model; relative to the more limiting single view, it improves OfficeQA Pass@1 by 8.3-12.1 points and APEX mean rubric score by 4.7-9.2 points. SW-AGENT scores 63.9% with Gemini 3.1 Pro on OfficeQA and 42.1 with GPT-5.4 Nano on APEX, compared with published same-model scores of 29.3% and 25.5, respectively. A paired review-axis ablation on 57 file-editing tasks further finds higher observed scores when diffs are visible. These results identify workspace state as an experimental variable in knowledge-work agents and motivate benchmarks that score evidence, staged edits, and submitted artifacts as explicit state transitions.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 关于AI工作代理的版本化工作区，与隐私计算、安全推理或大模型安全无关。
papers.title_zh: StagedWorkspace：面向知识工作智能体的版本化工作区
papers.abstract_zh: AI 智能体越来越多地执行知识工作（即生成和修改持久化数字工件，如代码仓库、文档、电子表格、幻灯片、报告），然而它们搜索的解析视图、编辑的原生文件、审阅的更改以及提交的工件可能指向同一工作产品的不同版本。我们将此表述为工作区状态契约：每个视图都应显式绑定到不断演化的工作区状态的某个版本。编码智能体通过针对搜索、差异和测试的仓库契约部分解决了这一需求，而对于 PDF、电子表格、幻灯片、笔记本和混合格式项目文件夹，类似契约则不那么明确。我们提出 StagedWorkspace，一个面向知识工作智能体的版本化工作区。该工作区随着原生文件的变化，将解析记录和审阅差异绑定到原生文件的内容哈希上。在 OfficeQA Pro 和 APEX-Agents 上的固定测试框架消融实验中，双重解析/原生访问在每个受测模型上都取得了最高的点估计值；相对于更受限的单一视图，它将 OfficeQA Pass@1 提高了 8.3-12.1 个点，将 APEX 平均评分得分提高了 4.7-9.2 个点。SW-AGENT 在 OfficeQA 上使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 得分为 63.9%，在 APEX 上使用 GPT-5.4 Nano 得分为 42.1，而这两个模型已发表的同模型得分分别为 29.3% 和 25.5。一项在 57 个文件编辑任务上进行的配对审阅轴消融实验进一步发现，当差异可见时观测分数更高。这些结果将工作区状态确定为知识工作智能体中的一个实验变量，并推动了这样的基准测试：将证据、暂存编辑和提交的工件作为显式状态转换进行评分。

papers.title: Language Has Two Parameters: Narrative-Induced Semantic Plasticity and Phase-Sensitive Interpretation
papers.abstract: Language has two parameters. Count how often words occur together and you estimate amplitude, the strength of association. Word embeddings and attention weights refine that count, which sums every writer in the corpus together. This paper claims a second parameter, phase, which signed weights learned from a corpus do not supply. Phase exists only between meanings: it determines how coactivated meanings combine, and it can reverse what a meaning contributes while that meaning stays fully present. A speaker can set phase in the signal through linguistic form; encounters install phase relations and history distributes them. Population averaging deletes history-indexed phase: agent-deindexed corpora identify the population marginal state and determine no individual or dyadic state, at any scale. The standard transformer has no explicit representation for phase in frozen inference, and the interpretability program measuring progress by monosemanticity is optimizing against it: the coexistence it treats as a defect is the condition of allusion, irony, and quotation. Six predictions test whether a suppressed meaning stays active, whether encounter order changes what a phrase does, whether marking the signal changes how a shared phrase is taken, and whether a model given a history is changed by it or only informed about it. The claim defended is the weak version: interpretation requires a second relational parameter, signed, persistent, and indexed to individuals and dyads. Quantum probability is one notation for the parameter; nothing in the formalism claims quantum processes in the brain. The strong version, that the quantum calculus constrains these phenomena as signed classical models do not, rests on an encounter-order constraint not yet derived. The architecture the theory calls for is a language model with agent-indexed, phase-bearing semantic states.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 提出语言中相位参数的理论，讨论transformer解释性，不涉及安全推理或隐私计算。
papers.title_zh: 语言具有两个参数：叙事诱导的语义可塑性与相位敏感解读
papers.abstract_zh: 语言具有两个参数。统计词语共现的频率，你得到的是振幅，即关联强度。词嵌入和注意力权重对这一统计进行了细化，但它将语料库中的所有作者汇总在一起。本文主张存在第二个参数，即相位，而从语料库中习得的有符号权重并不能提供这一参数。相位仅存在于意义之间：它决定共同激活的意义如何组合，并且它可以在某个意义保持完全在场的同时反转该意义所做出的贡献。说话者可以通过语言形式在信号中设定相位；遭遇经历建立相位关系，历史分布它们。总体平均消除了以历史为索引的相位：去个体索引的语料库识别的是总体的边际状态，而不决定任何个体或二元状态，无论何种尺度。标准Transformer在冻结推理中没有对相位的显式表示，而以求单义性衡量进展的可解释性程序恰恰是在与之背道而驰：它所视为缺陷的共存在，恰恰是典故、反讽和引用的条件。六个预测检验以下问题：被抑制的意义是否保持活跃，遭遇顺序是否改变短语的功能，对信号的标记是否改变共享短语被理解的方式，以及一个被赋予历史的模型是被历史所改变还是仅仅被告知了历史。本文辩护的主张是弱版本：解读需要一个第二关系参数，该参数是有符号的、持久的，并且以个体和二元组为索引。量子概率是该参数的一种记法；该形式体系中没有任何内容声称大脑中存在量子过程。强版本——即量子演算像有符号经典模型做不到的那样约束这些现象——依赖于一个尚未推导出的遭遇顺序约束。该理论所要求架构是一个具有个体索引、承载相位的语义状态的语言模型。

papers.title: Where A Small Language Model Helps in Invoice Categorisation, Understood Through Embedding Geometry
papers.abstract: Categorising invoices into the correct General Ledger (GL) code underpins financial reporting and tax compliance. This is a skilled accounting judgement rather than a routine task: the correct category depends subtly on the nature of the purchasing business, the vendor and the invoice text. Whilst AI is increasingly being adopted across industries to automate tasks, including invoice categorisation, implementations built on in-house small language models (SLMs) can simultaneously reduce cost and improve data security, confidentiality, and interpretability. We investigate this approach by first analysing the pre-trained embedding geometry of a small sentence transformer (SBERT) and classic SLM (DeBERTa). The sentence-embedding space of this financial corpus is globally anisotropic but composed of locally isotropic clusters, extending prior token-level findings to sentence embeddings in a financial setting, and these clusters are strongly correlated with the vendor identity. SBERT fine-tuned on a single GPU reaches 0.96 accuracy on invoice classification, above both a zero-shot LLM and a vendor identity baseline, increasing performance for smaller, challenging categories and new clients. For this important generalisation problem, SBERT reaches 0.9 F1 with roughly 100 client-specific invoices, showing that an in-house SLM implementation is promising. Combining these results with geometric analysis shows that pre-trained embedding geometry is associated with classification performance and reveals a counterintuitive finding that a structured input that would help a human reader does not improve the SLM performance.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 聚焦发票分类的小语言模型微调与嵌入几何，虽提及数据保密性但非核心安全研究。
papers.title_zh: 通过嵌入几何理解小型语言模型在发票分类中的助益之处
papers.abstract_zh: 将发票分类到正确的总账（GL）代码是财务报告和税务合规的基础。这是一项需要熟练会计判断的工作，而非常规任务：正确的类别微妙地取决于采购业务的性质、供应商和发票文本。虽然AI在各行业中被越来越多地用于自动化任务（包括发票分类），但基于内部小型语言模型（SLMs）的实现可以同时降低成本并提高数据安全性、保密性和可解释性。我们通过首先分析小型句子转换器（SBERT）和经典SLM（DeBERTa）的预训练嵌入几何来研究这种方法。该金融语料库的句子嵌入空间全局呈各向异性，但由局部各向同性的簇组成，这将先前的token级发现扩展到了金融环境中的句子嵌入，并且这些簇与供应商身份强相关。在单个GPU上微调的SBERT在发票分类上达到0.96的准确率，高于零样本LLM和供应商身份基线，并提高了较小、困难类别和新客户的表现。对于这一重要的泛化问题，SBERT用大约100张客户特定发票达到0.9的F1，表明内部SLM实现颇具前景。将这些结果与几何分析相结合表明，预训练嵌入几何与分类性能相关，并揭示了一个反直觉的发现：有助于人类读者的结构化输入并不能提高SLM的性能。

papers.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.abstract: Humans continuously learn from experience, whereas conventional large language model (LLM) evaluations ignore the models' ability to improve through inference-time interaction. In this paper, we study how LLMs learn from iterative experience at test time, a setting we refer to as Chain-of-Experience (CoE), where models accumulate experiential traces through iterative interactions with self or environmental feedback to form a continual improvement loop beyond zero-shot inference. We instantiate CoE with diverse feedback mechanisms, including model self-feedback and environmental signals such as correctness or public coding test pass rates, and evaluate across math, coding, and knowledge domains using 8 LLMs, including GPT-5, Gemini-2.5 Pro, Claude-4.5 Sonnet. Our study shows that leveraging iterative experience consistently outperforms feedback-free baselines, achieving substantial gains with self feedback alone, alongside a 5.6% overall improvement and 19% lower API cost across tasks and models. We further show that combining complementary feedback channels (e.g., model and correctness signals) yields additional gains, and that CoE delivers higher accuracy per token than existing test-time strategies. We observe a positive correlation between LLM base ability and improvement capacity, and show that models remain robust under weak or spurious feedback, with different feedback contributing to distinct improvement aspects and most gains emerging early in the iterations.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 研究LLM测试时持续改进的链式经验方法，不涉及密码学或安全推理。
papers.title_zh: 面向持续大语言模型改进的经验链
papers.abstract_zh: 人类会持续从经验中学习，而传统的大语言模型评估忽视了模型通过推理时交互来提升能力的过程。在本文中，我们研究了大语言模型如何在测试时从迭代经验中学习，我们将这一设置称为经验链（Chain-of-Experience, CoE），在该设置中，模型通过与自身或环境反馈的迭代交互来积累经验轨迹，从而形成超越零样本推理的持续改进循环。我们通过多种反馈机制实例化CoE，包括模型自我反馈以及正确性或公共编程测试通过率等环境信号，并使用8个大语言模型（包括GPT-5、Gemini-2.5 Pro、Claude-4.5 Sonnet）在数学、编程和知识领域进行评估。我们的研究表明，利用迭代经验始终优于无反馈基线，仅使用自我反馈就能获得显著提升，同时在所有任务和模型上实现5.6%的总体改进和19%的API成本降低。我们进一步表明，结合互补的反馈通道（例如模型信号和正确性信号）能带来额外收益，并且CoE在每token准确率上优于现有的测试时策略。我们观察到LLM基础能力与改进能力之间存在正相关，并表明模型在弱反馈或虚假反馈下仍保持鲁棒性，不同的反馈有助于不同的改进方面，且大部分收益在迭代早期即已出现。

papers.title: Why GPT-Style Models Do Not Directly Transfer to Symbolic Music: Compression in the Wrong Coordinate System
papers.abstract: GPT-style models achieve strong performance by representing language with finite vocabularies of reusable discrete tokens. This success has motivated symbolic music tokenizations to treat recurring musical structures, such as chords, motifs, and phrases, as reusable units analogous to linguistic tokens. However, tokenization derives its advantage not from reusable combinations alone, but from compression: effective compression requires coordinates in which recurring regularities form stable and predictable conditional distributions. The key problem is therefore not to find larger musical combinations, but to discover the coordinate system in which musical facts become predictively compressible. We formulate the Effectiveness--Losslessness Framework and define tokenization as the construction of a predictively effective and relationally lossless coordinate system. The Predictive Effectiveness Principle defines the Fact--Token Boundary: decoupling and denesting construct coordinate interfaces that expose predictive regularities. The Relational Losslessness Principle defines the Token--State Boundary: tokenization stops before context-dependent relations are fixed, leaving their computation to model states. Controlled symbolic-music experiments validate these boundaries. Effective coordinate construction improves predictive compressibility, while fixed relational projections constrain contextual modeling. Sequence compaction alone does not guarantee predictive compression, while preserving contextual freedom allows higher-order musical organization to emerge without explicit structural labels. These results reveal why GPT-style models do not transfer directly across modalities: architectures transfer, but tokenization interfaces do not. Tokenization must discover effective representations while preserving the relational freedom from which contextual structure can emerge.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 讨论符号音乐模态下GPT风格模型的标记化压缩问题，与安全推理无关。
papers.title_zh: 为何GPT风格模型无法直接迁移至符号音乐：在错误坐标系中的压缩
papers.abstract_zh: GPT风格模型通过用可复用离散词元的有限词汇表表示语言，取得了强劲性能。这一成功促使符号音乐词元化将反复出现的音乐结构（如和弦、动机和乐句）视为类似于语言词元的可复用单元。然而，词元化的优势不仅来自可复用的组合，更来自压缩：有效的压缩需要这样的坐标系——在此坐标系中，反复出现的规律形成稳定且可预测的条件分布。因此，关键问题不是寻找更大的音乐组合，而是发现使音乐事实在预测上可压缩的坐标系。我们提出了有效性—无损性框架，并将词元化定义为构建一个预测有效且关系无损的坐标系。预测有效性原则定义了事实—词元边界：解耦与解嵌套构建出暴露预测规律的坐标接口。关系无损性原则定义了词元—状态边界：词元化在上下文相关关系被固定之前停止，将其计算留给模型状态。受控的符号音乐实验验证了这些边界。有效的坐标构建提高了预测可压缩性，而固定的关系投影则限制了上下文建模。仅靠序列紧凑化并不能保证预测压缩，而保留上下文自由度则允许高阶音乐组织在没有显式结构标签的情况下涌现。这些结果揭示了为什么GPT风格模型不能跨模态直接迁移：架构可以迁移，但词元化接口不能。词元化必须在发现有效表示的同时，保留上下文结构得以涌现所依赖的关系自由度。

papers.title: An Omitted Mode Is a Rare Rule: The Sampling-Verification Danger Law in Continuous Code World Models
papers.abstract: In the Code World Model paradigm an LLM synthesizes an executable world model that a classical planner searches, and the model is accepted when it reproduces sampled transitions. We ask what that acceptance certifies in continuous control. We define the pipeline's danger as an expected risk and isolate its exact factor: the probability that N i.i.d. gate rollouts all miss a critical event of probability r is exactly (1-r)^N; an independent acceptance sample adds its budget to the exponent. On three hybrid instruments the accepted mode-blind model is exploited: the planner is pinned at the mode boundary at a regret of nearly the whole attainable return. We prove a localization budget, valid at boundary points: models with Lipschitz constant at most L differing by eta at a point disagree above tolerance eps on a region of volume at least kappa((eta-eps)/L)^(d+m); the discontinuous reset modes studied pay no such budget. With real LLM synthesis, GPT-5.x repairs an omitted 1D clamp in 105 of 111 mode-containing draws -- every attempt exact on 50 of 56 instrument-stream blocks (95% CI [0.781, 0.960]). On 2D regions no artifact recovers the rule (0/156); eight targeted interventions leave the failure in place, and positive controls locate it: a located rule is not induced, while given form and location the constants follow exactly. A version-space certificate proves identification is class-relative: at the widest dose the declared fit succeeds in 20/20 blocks and every sample-consistent circle is within tolerance in 18/20. We prove a class of entry rules exactly consistent with every sample yet harmless at play, so identifiability is a measurable property of the instrument. Re-scoring all 1034 artifacts on independent samples confirms acceptance certifies sample consistency and no more: where the gate is provably informative it covers about two percent of the exploited planner's queries.

papers.title_zh: 被省略的模态是一条稀有规则：连续代码世界模型中的采样-验证危险定律
papers.abstract_zh: 在代码世界模型范式中，LLM 综合出一个可执行的世界模型，由经典规划器进行搜索；当该模型重现采样到的转移时，它就被接受。我们追问，在连续控制中，这种接受究竟证明了什么。我们将该管道的危险定义为期望风险，并分离出它的精确因子：N 个独立同分布的闸门推出全部错过概率为 r 的关键事件的概率恰好是 (1-r)^N；一个独立的接受样本将其预算加到指数上。在三种混合仪器上，被接受的模态盲模型被利用：规划器被钉在模态边界上，其遗憾几乎达到全部可达回报。我们证明了一个在边界点有效的局部化预算：Lipschitz 常数至多为 L、在某一点相差 eta 的模型，在一个体积至少为 kappa((eta-eps)/L)^(d+m) 的区域上，超过容差 eps 地不一致；所研究的不连续重置模态不支付这样的预算。在真实 LLM 综合中，GPT-5.x 在 111 次含有模态的抽取中修复了 105 次被省略的一维钳位——在 56 个仪器流块中的 50 个上，每一次尝试都精确（95% CI [0.781, 0.960]）。在二维区域上，没有任何伪影恢复该规则（0/156）；八次有针对性的干预使失败保持原状，而阳性对照定位了它：被定位的规则不会被诱导出来，而一旦给定了形式和位置，常数便会精确地遵循。版本空间证书证明了可辨识性是类别相对的：在最宽的剂量下，声明拟合在 20/20 个块中成功，并且每一个与样本一致的圆在 18/20 个块中都处于容差之内。我们证明了一类入口规则与每个样本精确一致，但在实际运行中无害，因此可辨识性是仪器的一个可测量属性。对所有 1034 个伪影在独立样本上重新评分，证实接受所证明的只是样本一致性，而别无其他：在闸门可证明具有信息性的地方，它覆盖了被利用的规划器查询的大约百分之二。

papers.title: CABLE: Extending the Reach of Memory Retrieval via Complementary Antecedent-Based Linking and Expansion
papers.abstract: As LLM agents operate across structured workflows and sessions, preserving long-term history does not ensure that later contexts can recover relevant evidence through a bounded memory interface. We study this evidence-reachability problem in long-term conversational memory, where retrieval still relies heavily on semantic similarity. This works well for topical recall, but it often misses earlier experiences, plans, or motivations that are semantically distant from the later events they help explain. Existing memory graphs provide cross-memory structure, yet links driven mainly by semantic overlap can duplicate what the host retriever already recovers. We argue that link construction should instead prioritize a sparse set of retriever-complementary associations. We present CABLE (Complementary Antecedent-Based Linking and Expansion), a plug-in augmentation that constructs links designed to extend the host retriever's direct semantic reach. For each new memory, CABLE generates antecedent-oriented queries, retrieves prior memories, subtracts candidates in the direct semantic neighborhood, and verifies the remainder before adding the accepted complementary associations into a sparse directed graph. At retrieval time, CABLE expands the host system's retrieved seeds along these links to surface implicit supporting evidence. We evaluate CABLE with A-MEM on LoCoMo and MA-LongMemEval, and further integrate it into SimpleMem and Mem0g on LoCoMo, using Qwen3.5-27B, DeepSeek-chat, and GPT-4o-mini. CABLE yields higher mean LLM-judge scores in every evaluated system-level setting, with the largest gains in categories where useful evidence is distributed across memories or sessions, including open-domain, multi-session, and preference-oriented questions. These results support prioritizing sparse, reasoning-relevant associations that complement rather than duplicate the host retriever.

papers.title_zh: CABLE：通过基于互补先例的链接与扩展延伸记忆检索的覆盖范围
papers.abstract_zh: 随着LLM智能体在结构化工作流和会话中运行，保留长期历史并不能确保后续上下文能够通过有界记忆接口恢复相关证据。我们研究了长期对话记忆中的证据可达性问题，其中检索仍然在很大程度上依赖语义相似性。这对于主题回忆效果良好，但常常遗漏与后续事件在语义上相距较远、却有助于解释这些事件的早期经验、计划或动机。现有记忆图提供了跨记忆结构，但主要由语义重叠驱动的链接可能会重复宿主检索器已经恢复的内容。我们认为，链接构建应优先考虑一组稀疏的、与检索器互补的关联。我们提出了CABLE（基于互补先例的链接与扩展），这是一种插件式增强方法，构建旨在扩展宿主检索器直接语义覆盖范围的链接。对于每条新记忆，CABLE生成面向先例的查询，检索先前的记忆，减去直接语义邻域中的候选，并在将接受的互补关联添加到稀疏有向图之前验证其余部分。在检索时，CABLE沿这些链接扩展宿主系统检索到的种子，以揭示隐含的支持性证据。我们在LoCoMo和MA-LongMemEval上使用A-MEM评估CABLE，并进一步将其集成到LoCoMo上的SimpleMem和Mem0g，使用Qwen3.5-27B、DeepSeek-chat和GPT-4o-mini。在每一个评估的系统级设置中，CABLE都产生了更高的平均LLM评判分数，在有用证据分布在不同记忆或会话中的类别中提升最大，包括开放域、多会话和偏好导向的问题。这些结果支持优先考虑稀疏的、与推理相关的、且与宿主检索器互补而非重复的关联。

papers.title: What Aggregate Scores Miss: Measuring Item-Level Regressions in Commercial LLM API Migrations
papers.abstract: Context: Software systems that depend on commercial large language model APIs must migrate to successor versions when vendors deprecate older models. Migration decisions typically rely on aggregate benchmark scores, which compress heterogeneous item-level behaviour into a single net figure. Objective: We measure what that compression conceals. Method: On three pairwise upgrades in the GPT-5.4 to GPT-5.6 Sol product sequence, we query 900 public benchmark items (graduate-level knowledge, olympiad mathematics, instruction following) 50 times per item per model, classify each item as reliably improved, reliably regressed, practically equivalent, or inconclusive under false-discovery-rate control and a practical-significance threshold, and calibrate the results against a label-permutation null. Results: Across all nine migration-benchmark cells, reliable improvements and reliable regressions coexist. Edges with aggregate gains of up to 7.3 percentage points contain up to 8.3% reliably regressed items; edges with aggregate losses contain up to 10.7% reliably improved items. On the instruction-following benchmark, the gap between strict and loose scoring widens by 3.9 percentage points on the latest migration: a 3.9-point regression under strict scoring shrinks to 0.04 points under loose scoring. Conclusion: Migration decisions based on aggregate scores alone miss substantial bidirectional item-level change. The complete response-level archive and per-item scoring outputs are released.

papers.title_zh: 聚合分数遗漏了什么：衡量商业LLM API迁移中的条目级回归
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：依赖商业大语言模型API的软件系统，在供应商弃用旧模型时必须迁移到后继版本。迁移决策通常依赖聚合基准分数，而聚合分数将异质的条目级行为压缩为一个单一净值。目标：我们衡量这种压缩所掩盖的内容。方法：在GPT-5.4到GPT-5.6 Sol产品序列的三次两两升级中，我们对900个公共基准条目（研究生水平知识、奥林匹克数学、指令遵循）每个模型每个条目查询50次，在错误发现率控制和实际显著性阈值下，将每个条目分类为可靠改进、可靠回归、实际等价或不确定，并将结果与标签置换零假设进行校准。结果：在所有九个迁移-基准单元中，可靠改进和可靠回归并存。聚合增益高达7.3个百分点的迁移边包含高达8.3%的可靠回归条目；聚合损失的迁移边包含高达10.7%的可靠改进条目。在指令遵循基准上，最新迁移中严格评分与宽松评分之间的差距扩大了3.9个百分点：严格评分下3.9个百分点的回归在宽松评分下缩小至0.04个百分点。结论：仅基于聚合分数的迁移决策会遗漏大量的双向条目级变化。完整的响应级存档和逐条目评分输出已发布。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Expert Blocks Contain Strong Hallucination Detection Signals
papers.abstract: Despite their widespread use, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited by a fundamental problem: the generation of plausible but false content, known as hallucinations. Most existing detection methods operate at the answer or sentence level, yet per-token detection is essential for localizing hallucinated spans and enabling fine-grained interventions. In this paper, we explore the use of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address this gap. In MoE architectures, a single forward pass activates a sparse subset of experts (i.e., distinct feedforward networks per layer) via a routing mechanism, producing internal signals (e.g., router entropy, expert disagreement, and expert usage patterns) that are unavailable in dense architectures and have not been previously exploited for hallucination detection. To this end, we introduce InnerExpert, the first method to leverage these MoE-specific signals for per-token hallucination detection. InnerExpert combines routing-level and standard transformer signals into compact per-token feature vectors, classified by a lightweight detector trained on labels produced by an LLM-as-a-judge pipeline, which enables continuous model updates without manual annotation. Our results show that InnerExpert outperforms existing methods across five datasets and two MoE architectures, achieving up to 0.91 answer-level and 0.76 token-level AUROC, while requiring only a single forward pass.

papers.title_zh: 混合专家模块包含强幻觉检测信号
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLMs）被广泛使用，它们仍然受到一个根本问题的限制：生成看似合理但虚假的内容，即幻觉。大多数现有检测方法在答案或句子级别运行，然而逐词元检测对于定位幻觉片段和实现细粒度干预至关重要。在本文中，我们探索使用混合专家（MoE）范式来弥补这一空白。在MoE架构中，单次前向传播通过路由机制激活稀疏的专家子集（即每层不同的前馈网络），产生在密集架构中不可用且此前未被用于幻觉检测的内部信号（例如路由熵、专家分歧和专家使用模式）。为此，我们提出了InnerExpert，这是首个利用这些MoE特有信号进行逐词元幻觉检测的方法。InnerExpert将路由级信号和标准Transformer信号组合成紧凑的逐词元特征向量，由在LLM-as-a-judge流程生成的标签上训练的轻量级检测器进行分类，从而实现无需人工标注的持续模型更新。我们的结果表明，InnerExpert在五个数据集和两种MoE架构上优于现有方法，实现了高达0.91的答案级AUROC和0.76的词元级AUROC，且仅需单次前向传播。

papers.title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing
papers.abstract: What a reasoning model writes is only a partial record of the process that produces it. We introduce a two-level internal readout for mixture-of-experts reasoning. We first distill vocabulary-scale J-space into J64, a 64-axis semantic frame learned from the model's own reasoning states. J64 reveals readable process state that the emitted trace does not show: it separates inference effort from problem-induced strain. It also adds 0.096 to 0.135 held-out AUC over a baseline that reads the same rollout as token occupancy and aggregates it in exactly the same way. We then reconstruct J64 from native expert-routing statistics. The result is R64, a low-overhead proxy: its median per-axis correlation with J64 is 0.69 to 0.86 across three models and two families, and on gpt-oss-20b it preserves 95 to 100% of J64's predictive gain. The readout supports test-time decisions at two temporal resolutions. Over completed candidate sets, J64 and R64 improve single-branch selection, and R64-weighted voting improves plain majority voting in seven of eight settings. During generation, rolling readout windows drive a cumulative stop-and-resample policy whose operating point is fixed on training questions alone. J64 improves accuracy by 1.1 to 5.9 points over a sibling-permuted control, and the routing-only R64 proxy retains 0.9 to 3.2 of those points. Finally, router edits aimed at the mechanism J64 names induce the predicted reasoning behaviors and shift a diagnosed stall from numerical guessing toward exact symbolic execution. Together, J64 makes latent process state readable, while routing makes it deployable and actionable.

papers.title_zh: 超越轨迹：将可解释的推理状态读出与原生MoE路由相耦合
papers.abstract_zh: 推理模型所写下的内容仅是产生该内容过程的局部记录。我们为混合专家（mixture-of-experts）推理引入了一种两级内部读出机制。我们首先将词表规模的J空间蒸馏为J64——一个从模型自身推理状态中学习得到的64轴语义框架。J64揭示了所输出轨迹未能展示的可读过程状态：它将推理努力与问题引发的张力分离开来。与以词元占用（token occupancy）方式读取相同展开（rollout）并以完全相同方式聚合的基线相比，它还将留出集AUC提高了0.096至0.135。随后，我们从原生专家路由统计量中重建J64，得到R64——一种低开销代理：在三个模型和两个模型家族中，其与J64的逐轴中位相关系数为0.69至0.86，并且在gpt-oss-20b上，它保留了J64预测增益的95%至100%。该读出机制在两个时间分辨率上支持测试时决策。在已完成的候选集上，J64和R64改善了单分支选择，并且R64加权投票在八种设置中的七种中优于普通多数投票。在生成过程中，滚动读出窗口驱动一种累积的停止并重采样策略，其工作点仅基于训练问题固定。J64相对于同源置换（sibling-permuted）对照将准确率提高了1.1至5.9个百分点，而仅基于路由的R64代理保留了其中的0.9至3.2个百分点。最后，针对J64所指认机制的路由器编辑（router edits）诱导出所预测的推理行为，并将已诊断的停滞从数值猜测转向精确符号执行。综上所述，J64使潜在过程状态变得可读，而路由使其可部署且可操作。

papers.title: Unclonable encryption from BB84 states: a simultaneous Goldreich-Levin reduction
papers.abstract: Goldreich-Levin reductions are ubiquitous in cryptography: they convert an algorithm capable of guessing $\langle r, m \rangle$ (mod $2$) for a hidden string $m$ and a random challenge $r$, to one that is capable of extracting the entirety of $m$. Here, we describe a "simultaneous" Goldreich-Levin reduction for two entangled parties who are capable of guessing $\langle r, m \rangle$ given uniformly random identical challenges $r$. This allows to upgrade any unclonable encryption scheme satisfying "search" security to one satisfying the gold standard of unclonable "indistinguishability". As a corollary, we show that the simplest candidate unclonable encryption scheme from BB84 states satisfies unclonable indistinguishability. This result was discovered by GPT-5.6 Ultra after a few interactions. Our prompts included recent results on unclonable encryption by Ananth and Sahai, and Ragavan.

papers.summary_zh:
### 一句话结论
本文提出一种面向两个纠缠敌手的“同时”Goldreich-Levin 归约，可将搜索安全的不可克隆加密方案升级为满足不可克隆不可区分性，并由此证明基于 BB84 态的最简候选方案达到不可克隆不可区分性。

### 问题与动机
不可克隆加密（unclonable encryption）旨在防止量子敌手复制密文后分别进行解密。现有方案常以“搜索安全”（search security）为安全性目标，但密码学上更理想的是“不可克隆不可区分性”（unclonable indistinguishability）——即敌手无法区分密文对应哪个明文。Goldreich-Levin 归约是经典密码学工具，它能把“猜测内积 \(\langle r, m \rangle \pmod 2\)”的能力转化为“提取整个隐藏串 \(m\)”的能力。本文要处理的关键场景是：两个相互纠缠的敌手面对**同一个随机挑战 \(r\)**，各自输出对内积的猜测；经典 Goldreich-Levin 归约并不直接适用于这种“同时”且挑战相同的设定。

### 方法与技术路线
- **研究对象与设定**：考虑两个共享纠缠态的量子敌手，他们获得相同的均匀随机挑战 \(r\)，各自需要猜测 \(\langle r, m \rangle \pmod 2\)，其中 \(m\) 是隐藏字符串。作者构造一个“同时”Goldreich-Levin 归约：若这两个纠缠方能够以非平凡概率同时正确猜出内积，那么就可以提取出完整的 \(m\)。摘要未说明该归约具体的量子操作步骤、成功概率阈值或参数设置。
- **核心思想**：传统 Goldreich-Levin 归约通常需要独立且随机的挑战；此处为了适配两个敌手收到**相同**挑战 \(r\)，需要引入同时性。作者将这一归约作为模块，用于升级加密方案：任何满足搜索安全的不可克隆加密方案，都可以通过该归约被转换为满足不可克隆不可区分性的方案。摘要未披露从搜索安全到不可区分性的具体构造流程、编码方式或安全性归约细节。
- **应用与验证**：将上述升级应用于最简单的候选方案——基于 BB84 量子态构造的不可克隆加密。作者声称该方案满足不可克隆不可区分性。摘要未说明使用了什么数据集、实验环境或数值指标；这是理论证明而非实验评估。

### 主要结果
1. 建立了适用于两个纠缠方的“同时”Goldreich-Levin 归约。  
2. 给出了一个通用升级路径：搜索安全 → 不可克隆不可区分性。  
3. 推论：BB84 态的最简不可克隆加密方案达到不可克隆不可区分性。  
另外，摘要指出该结果由 GPT-5.6 Ultra 在几次交互后发现，提示内容涉及 Ananth 与 Sahai、Ragavan 关于不可克隆加密的近期工作。

### 为什么与兴趣相关
不可克隆加密是量子密码学中的基础原语，直接关联“量子信息不可克隆”这一物理特性；Goldreich-Levin 归约则是密码学中提取硬核谓词信息的经典工具。本文将这一工具推广到纠缠敌手和相同挑战的情形，可能对量子安全协议设计与安全性证明有方法论启示。尽管该主题与大模型安全推理没有直接关系，但理解量子敌手模型下的不可克隆性，有助于从更底层视角思考数据安全与防复制需求。

papers.title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
papers.abstract: We present MoNe, a lightweight modular neural memory that attaches to any frozen pretrained Transformer to enable long-context inference without retraining. MoNe reads context in fixed-size segments via test-time learning of fast-weight neural memory networks with layer-localized gradient updates; at inference, the memory generates keys and values from the query tokens alone, with no context tokens re-read. This two-phase design decouples inference cost from context length, achieving $O(N)$ preprocessing and $O(1)$ query cost with peak GPU memory that does not grow with $N$. At 128K tokens, MoNe reduces both compute and peak GPU memory by approximately 80% compared to ICL with only 6.4% parameter overhead. MoNe generalizes to context lengths far beyond the backbone's native window, achieving strong performance on needle-in-a-haystack and word extraction benchmarks from RULER, where ICL degrades sharply.

papers.title_zh: MoNe：面向高效长上下文推理的模块化神经记忆
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了MoNe，一种轻量级模块化神经记忆，可附加到任何冻结的预训练Transformer上，无需重新训练即可实现长上下文推理。MoNe通过测试时学习具有层局部梯度更新的快速权重神经记忆网络，以固定大小的分段读取上下文；在推理时，记忆仅从查询词元生成键和值，不重新读取上下文词元。这种两阶段设计将推理成本与上下文长度解耦，实现了$O(N)$的预处理和$O(1)$的查询成本，且峰值GPU内存不随$N$增长。在128K词元下，与ICL相比，MoNe的计算量和峰值GPU内存均减少约80%，而参数开销仅为6.4%。MoNe能够泛化到远超骨干网络原生窗口的上下文长度，在RULER的needle-in-a-haystack和单词提取基准上取得了强劲性能，而ICL在这些基准上性能急剧下降。

papers.title: TRUSS: Towards Task-Reliable and User-Safe Automated Agent Skill Generation
papers.abstract: Agent Skills package reusable natural language procedures with executable resources, enabling software agents to acquire task specific capabilities without model adaptation. Automatically generating such Skills can improve task performance, yet evaluating a candidate solely from its artifact or final task outcome leaves unresolved which actions the equipped agent will perform and which side effects those actions will produce. We present TRUSS, an evidence guided framework for generating functionally effective and safety reliable Agent Skills. TRUSS first inspects functional claims against source and domain evidence while evaluating the complete artifact under nine predefined safety properties. Candidates admitted by this static gate are loaded by a shadow agent inside a Controllable Execution Environment, where brokered tools expose requested actions to policy enforcement and record their results as provenance preserving execution traces. Functional failures and property violations are linked back to the responsible Skill content and used to guide iterative refinement. We evaluate TRUSS on 168 SkillInject artifacts, 155 SkillSafetyBench cases, and all 187 tasks in SkillGenBench. TRUSS achieves 100.00\% precision and recall in vulnerability detection. Repair reduces attack success from 38.71\% to 19.35\% with GPT 5.5 and from 46.45\% to 29.68\% with GPT 5.4, with zero attack regression. For Skill generation, TRUSS raises task effectiveness from 17.11\% without Skills to 52.94\%, while increasing the benchmark Security rate from 50.80\% to 100.00\%. These results show that execution evidence can expose behavioral failures missed by artifact inspection and can guide Skill generation toward jointly verified functional and safety outcomes.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 聚焦Agent技能生成的安全性与漏洞修复，属大模型应用安全而非安全推理。
papers.summary_zh:
### 一句话结论
TRUSS 是一个证据引导的 Agent Skill（智能体技能）自动生成框架，通过“静态安全审查 + 可控执行验证”的联合机制，实现既有任务效果又具备安全可靠性的技能生成。

### 问题与动机
Agent Skills 将可复用的自然语言流程与可执行资源打包，使软件智能体无需调整模型即可获得特定任务能力。自动生成这类技能能提升任务表现，但若只依据技能产物或最终任务结果来评估候选技能，则无法确定配备该技能后智能体实际会执行哪些动作、这些动作又会产生什么副作用。因此需要一种更可靠的生成与验证方法。

### 方法与技术路线
TRUSS 采用“静态检查—动态执行—迭代修复”的三阶段证据引导流程：

1. **静态门禁（artifact inspection）**  
   对候选技能同时进行两类检查：一方面对照来源与领域证据核验其功能声明；另一方面基于九项预定义安全属性评估完整技能产物。只有通过此静态门禁的候选技能才会进入下一阶段。摘要未说明九项安全属性的具体内容和判定规则。

2. **可控执行与行为记录**  
   通过静态审查的候选技能由“影子代理”（shadow agent）在“可控执行环境”（Controllable Execution Environment）中实际加载运行。环境中的“代理工具”（brokered tools）将技能请求的动作暴露给策略执行，并记录执行结果，形成保留来源的完整执行轨迹（provenance preserving execution traces）。这一步解决静态检查无法捕捉运行期行为的问题。

3. **反馈引导的迭代改进**  
   将运行期间出现的功能失败和属性违规，反向定位到对应的技能内容，据此指导技能迭代修复。由此形成“生成—验证—修复”的闭环，使最终技能同时满足功能与安全要求。

### 主要结果
在 168 个 SkillInject 工件、155 个 SkillSafetyBench 案例和全部 187 个 SkillGenBench 任务上，TRUSS 在漏洞检测中达到 100.00% 的精确率与召回率。修复能力方面，攻击成功率在 GPT 5.5 下从 38.71% 降至 19.35%，在 GPT 5.4 下从 46.45% 降至 29.68%，且零攻击回归。技能生成效果方面，任务有效性从无技能时的 17.11% 提升到 52.94%，基准安全率从 50.80% 提升到 100.00%。

### 为什么与兴趣相关
该工作表明，仅靠产物静态检查会遗漏实际行为层面的失败；引入执行证据可以暴露这些隐藏问题，并引导技能朝功能与安全联合验证的方向改进。这对大模型驱动的智能体应用安全具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: DMT-Dens: Density-preserving manifold visualization for biological data
papers.abstract: Motivation: Low-dimensional embeddings are widely used to explore cell-state heterogeneity in single-cell and other high-dimensional biological data. Although many methods preserve local neighborhoods, they may distort the apparent sampling density of processed observations, altering the visual contrast between dense and sparse regions and complicating the interpretation of rare, transitional, or continuous cell-state populations. Results: We present DMT-Dens, a parametric manifold-visualization method built on a latent-token Transformer encoder. The model integrates rank-based manifold alignment with hard-pair aggregation. To preserve density, it optimizes a loss based on the Pearson correlation between k-nearest-neighbor log-radius estimates in the processed input and two-dimensional embedding spaces. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong density preservation, particularly on biological datasets, while retaining competitive label separability. Availability: Source code, data-processing scripts, and resolved experiment configurations are available at https://github.com/Ruizhe-wang/DMT-Dens.

papers.title_zh: DMT-Dens：面向生物数据的密度保持流形可视化
papers.abstract_zh: 动机：低维嵌入被广泛用于探索单细胞和其他高维生物数据中的细胞状态异质性。尽管许多方法能够保留局部邻域，但它们可能会扭曲处理后的观测数据的表观采样密度，改变致密区域与稀疏区域之间的视觉对比，并使稀有、过渡或连续的细胞状态群体的解释复杂化。结果：我们提出了 DMT-Dens，一种基于潜在标记 Transformer 编码器的参数化流形可视化方法。该模型将基于秩的流形对齐与硬对聚合相结合。为了保持密度，它优化了一个基于处理后的输入和二维嵌入空间中 k 最近邻对数半径估计之间的皮尔逊相关性的损失。基准评估表明，该方法具有强大的密度保持能力，尤其在生物数据集上，同时保持了有竞争力的标签可分性。可用性：源代码、数据处理脚本和已解析的实验配置可在 https://github.com/Ruizhe-wang/DMT-Dens 获取。

papers.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications often face the risks of specially crafted prompts designed to bypass the safety controls. Existing guardrail methods, such as LLM-as-a-judge and cloud-based safety APIs are able to detect unsafe content. However, they often add a delay of about 250-900 ms to each request. This delay is too high for real-time applications, when the system usually needs to respond in less than 100 ms. Furthermore, routing user prompts through external moderation endpoints raises significant data privacy concerns. This paper introduces Reflex-Guard, a lightweight guardrail that runs locally. # Reflex-Guard：基于稠密语义嵌入的低延迟 LLM 提示安全关卡

## 一句话结论
Reflex-Guard 是一个完全本地运行的轻量级提示安全过滤（guardrail）方法，利用越狱感知预处理、紧凑句子嵌入和多个快速二分类器，在 37.6 ms 端到端延迟下对有害提示达到 95.9% 召回，同时避免了云端审核带来的隐私风险。

## 问题与动机
大语言模型（LLM）在实际应用中经常面临专门构造的、试图绕过安全控制的恶意提示。现有的 guardrail 方法，如 LLM-as-a-judge（用大模型评判安全性）和基于云的安全 API，虽然能检测不安全内容，但每个请求会引入约 250–900 ms 延迟，远高于实时应用通常要求的 <100 ms 响应时间。此外，将用户提示发送到外部审核端点还会带来严重的数据隐私问题。

## 方法与技术路线
- **研究对象与设定**：Reflex-Guard 针对的是 LLM 输入端的 prompt safety filtering（提示安全过滤），目标是实时拦截有害提示。它整体在本地运行，不需要调用外部服务，因此兼顾延迟与隐私。
- **关键模块与衔接**：系统由三个主要组件构成：
  1. **jailbreak-aware preprocessing**（越狱感知预处理）：先对输入提示做针对常见越狱模式的预处理，为后续嵌入和分类器提供更易识别的输入。
  2. **compact sentence-transformer embeddings**（紧凑句子嵌入）：将预处理后的提示转换为稠密语义向量，使得语义相似的不同攻击变体能够映射到相近的表征区域。
  3. **七个快速二分类器**：基于嵌入向量并行或级联判断提示是否有害。七个独立分类器被设计为在保持高准确率的同时降低单次推理耗时。
- **实验评估方式**：摘要说明，作者在一个由五个互补来源构建、包含 30,568 个样本的策略性平衡数据集上进行了系统评估。比较对象包括 Llama Guard 2 和 SafeDecoding，主要指标有延迟、召回率、攻击检测率和 Reflex Efficiency Score（RES，综合效率得分）。
- **摘要未说明**：具体预处理规则、句子嵌入模型的架构与参数、七个二分类器的结构和训练细节、阈值默认值的设定方法以及运行硬件环境均未在摘要中披露，因此这里不做推测。

## 主要结果
- Reflex-Guard 的端到端延迟为 **37.6 ms**，显著快于 Llama Guard 2 的 255 ms 和 SafeDecoding 的 723 ms。
- 在有害提示上实现 **95.9% 召回**。
- 对 GCG suffix 攻击（一种针对白盒 LLM 的对抗后缀攻击）和 Base64 编码的提示，在默认阈值下检测率均达到 **100%**。
- 对 DrAttack 这类结构化越狱提示，默认阈值下检测效果不佳，需要将阈值降至 **0.03** 才能获得最优检测，原因是它们产生了独特的概率分布。
- Reflex Efficiency Score（RES）最高达 **16.79**，超过 Llama Guard 2（11.90）和 SafeDecoding（9.80）。

## 为什么与兴趣相关
低延迟是实时对话系统等场景的硬性要求，Reflex-Guard 展示了“本地轻量模型 + 嵌入 + 快速分类”在满足延迟约束方面的实用性；同时，本地运行避免了用户数据外泄风险，对隐私敏感型应用尤其重要。此外，摘要指出不同攻击类型在嵌入概率空间中占据不同区域，这一发现既可用于指导实际部署时的阈值调整，也提示了针对攻击家族做专用检测的潜在方向。

papers.title: CryptDough: A Unified Analytics Engine for Secure Multiparty Computation
papers.abstract: We present CryptDough, a unified analytics engine for secure multiparty computation (MPC). CryptDough enables multiple distrusting parties to jointly execute a data analysis pipeline on their private inputs and learn nothing beyond the result (e.g., aggregate statistics). Unlike existing MPC solutions that support a single threat model or workload type, CryptDough provides built-in support for cross-domain analytics (relational, time series, ML inference) under various threat models, all within the same system runtime. CryptDough contributes (i) a hierarchical system design that facilitates modularity and extensibility through progressive lowering of abstractions, and (ii) the concept of virtual vectors that enable users to write single-threaded code across all layers of the software stack, while pushing the complexity of communication, parallelization, and memory management down to the execution engine. We show that CryptDough generalizes the functionality of state-of-the-art MPC systems and remains competitive on the analytics they support, often outperforming them by more than $2\times$.

papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论

CryptDough 是一个面向安全多方计算（MPC）的统一分析引擎，允许互不信任的各方在私有输入上联合执行数据分析，且除结果外不泄露其他信息；它通过分层系统设计和“虚拟向量”抽象，在多种威胁模型下支持关系、时间序列和机器学习推理等分析负载，并能在已有 MPC 系统支持的任务上常获得超过 2 倍的性能提升。

## 问题与动机

现有 MPC 解决方案通常只服务单一威胁模型或单一工作负载类型，难以灵活应对实际分析中混合关系查询、时间序列处理和 ML 推理等需求。CryptDough 的目标是在同一个系统运行时内，原生支持跨领域分析，并兼容多种威胁模型，从而让用户无需为不同任务切换或定制安全计算系统。

## 方法与技术路线

- **研究对象与设定**：面向多个彼此不信任的数据持有方，需要联合执行数据分析管道；输入是各方的私有数据，输出是聚合统计等分析结果，且各方“除了结果什么都学不到”（摘要未说明具体安全定义或协议细节）。
- **核心设计一：分层系统架构（hierarchical system design）**：通过“渐进式降低抽象”（progressive lowering of abstractions）实现模块化和可扩展性。即上层用户表达分析意图，系统逐层翻译到更底层的执行表示；这种设计便于在不同威胁模型或分析类型间复用/替换组件。摘要未说明具体分层层次或各层接口。
- **核心设计二：虚拟向量（virtual vectors）**：它使用户可以在整个软件栈的每一层都编写单线程风格的代码，而把通信、并行化和内存管理等分布式复杂度全部“下推”给执行引擎。这样，上层分析逻辑与底层并行/安全执行解耦，从而简化编程并支撑跨领域负载的统一表达。
- **技术衔接**：虚拟向量解决的是“如何统一、简化编程”的问题；分层架构解决的是“如何组织模块以支持多威胁模型和多分析类型”的问题。两者结合，使得同一运行时既能保持表达灵活性，又能将底层通信与调度优化集中到执行引擎中。摘要中未说明具体的密码学原语（如秘密分享、混淆电路等）、协议步骤、参数或实验设置。

## 主要结果

摘要指出，CryptDough 在功能上能够概括（generalizes）当前最先进的 MPC 系统，并且在这些系统支持的分析任务上保持竞争力，性能常常超过它们 2 倍以上（“often outperforming them by more than $2\times$”）。摘要未披露所比较的系统名称、具体数据集、任务负载或威胁模型实例，也未给出详细性能数字。

## 为什么与兴趣相关

尽管 CryptDough 支持 ML 推理，但它本质上是一个通用 MPC 分析引擎，而非专门面向安全推理优化的协议。它的价值在于：为多种分析类型和威胁模型提供统一运行时，降低 MPC 应用开发门槛，并保持有竞争力的性能。对于关注 MPC 实用化、跨域数据联合分析和系统抽象设计的研究者，这是一个值得关注的系统框架，但若需要深入验证其安全性与性能，应进一步查阅原文或同行评审版本。

> 注：本文严格基于原始摘要撰写，未补充摘要之外的方法细节、实验数据或安全结论。

papers.title: FESC: Remodeling Long-Context Private Inference with Encrypted State-Space Models
papers.abstract: Processing long, sensitive documents with machine-learning models requires efficient, privacy-preserving long-context inference. Prior private inference systems optimize or distribute encrypted Transformer attention, but its quadratic token-pair work remains the bottleneck as sequence length grows. Selective state-space models (SSMs) offer linear-time recurrence, yet direct encrypted implementation incurs linear multiplicative depth, sequence-wide state residency, or dense FHE-MPC conversion. We present Factorized Encrypted Scan-Contract (FESC), a hybrid FHE-MPC system for private long-context selective SSM inference. Its factorized scan-contract keeps input-dependent transitions compact across conversion boundaries, composes them without dense expansion, streams state chunks on demand, and contracts outputs before conversion. We demonstrate interface compatibility of the scan-contract implementation across invariant and selective SSM architectures. For our Mamba-2 instantiation, we design GPU-optimized CKKS kernels for linear computations, MPC protocols for SiLU, softplus, exponential, and RMSNorm, with approximation-aware fine-tuning. To our knowledge, FESC is the first private long-document inference system to complete native end-to-end execution at $L \geq 1{,}024$ on a single GPU. At $L = 2{,}048$, a 12-layer Mamba-base model completes inference in 77.3 minutes on one A100 GPU with a peak memory footprint of 32.7 GB, while maintaining near-plaintext accuracy on the evaluated long-document tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
## 一句话结论
FESC 是一个混合 FHE-MPC（全同态加密与安全多方计算）系统，用于私有长上下文选择性 SSM（状态空间模型）推理，首次实现在单张 GPU 上以原生端到端方式完成 L≥1024 的序列推理。

## 问题与动机
处理长且敏感的文档需要高效且保护隐私的推理。此前的私有推理系统主要优化或分布式加密 Transformer 注意力，但其对 token 对的二次方计算量会随序列长度增长成为瓶颈。选择性 SSM 具有线性时间递归优势，但直接加密实现会遭遇线性乘法深度、序列级状态驻留或密集 FHE-MPC 转换等问题。

## 方法与技术路线
- **研究对象与设定**：面向私有长上下文选择性 SSM 推理，采用混合 FHE-MPC 架构。摘要未说明具体协议步骤、参数和数据集。
- **核心模块：factorized scan-contract**（因式化扫描-收缩）：将输入依赖的转换在转换边界保持紧凑形式；组合转换时无需密集展开；按需流式加载状态块；在转换前收缩输出。这一设计避免了直接加密实现中的密度和驻留问题。
- **实例化与计算分配**：在 Mamba-2 架构中，线性计算使用 GPU 优化的 CKKS 内核（一种近似同态加密方案）；非线性函数如 SiLU、softplus、exponential 和 RMSNorm 则通过 MPC 协议实现；并采用近似感知微调来配合近似计算。
- **衔接关系**：FHE 负责线性部分，MPC 处理非线性部分，scan-contract 负责在两者转换边界处保持数据紧凑并管理状态流，从而降低开销。摘要还提到该实现接口兼容 invariant 和 selective 两类 SSM 架构。

## 主要结果
FESC 被描述为首个能在单 GPU 上完成原生端到端私有长文档推理的系统，支持 L≥1024。在 L=2048 时，一个 12 层 Mamba-base 模型在单张 A100 GPU 上 77.3 分钟完成推理，峰值内存 32.7 GB，并在所评估的长文档任务上保持接近明文准确率。

## 为什么与兴趣相关
这项研究直接回应了长上下文私有推理中 Transformer 注意力的二次方瓶颈，验证了利用 SSM 线性递归的可行性，并展示了单 GPU 上运行长序列私有推理的实际效果，对安全机器学习部署具有参考价值。

papers.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets
papers.abstract: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluation protocol for black-box jailbreak attacks under shared target-call budgets B, using target calls as a directly observable and method-agnostic comparison axis while tracking attacker calls separately for efficiency analysis. We re-evaluate 11 representative attacks under the Fair-ASR protocol and find that attack rankings change substantially across target-call budgets, simple stochastic perturbations and hand-crafted templates remain highly competitive under equal target access, and no evaluated LLM-driven method is efficient in both target and attacker calls. Motivated by this efficiency gap, we introduce ReCode, a compositional budget-efficient attack that combines desensitization rewriting with two effective low-cost primitives identified by Fair-ASR. Under a budget of 20 target calls, ReCode achieves 85% ASR on GPT-5 while requiring only 7.19 attacker calls per request on average, showing strong efficiency in both target and attacker calls.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 黑盒越狱攻击评估，属大模型安全但非安全推理。
papers.summary_zh:
# 一句话结论

本文提出 Fair-ASR 评估协议，在共享目标调用预算下重新评估黑盒越狱攻击，发现攻击排名随预算显著变化，并提出高效攻击 ReCode。

# 问题与动机

可靠的越狱评估对判断大语言模型（LLM）安全性至关重要，但多数现有研究只报告攻击成功率（ASR），没有考虑其与攻击预算的依赖关系，导致不同方法之间的比较不公平。已有的计算感知评估将异构资源折算为 FLOPs（浮点运算次数），但对黑盒模型很难进行估计，也无法捕捉特定资源带来的约束。因此需要一种可比较的评估基准。

# 方法与技术路线

- **研究对象与设定**：黑盒越狱攻击，即攻击者只能通过查询目标模型来判断和构造可诱发不安全输出的输入。
- **评估对象**：11 种代表性攻击，在 Fair-ASR 协议下重新评估。
- **关键步骤 / 协议逻辑**：Fair-ASR 以目标调用次数 B（对目标模型的查询次数）作为直接可观测、且与具体方法无关的比较轴；同时单独记录攻击者调用次数（攻击者自身生成或优化时消耗的调用）用于效率分析。这样可以在相同的目标访问额度下比较不同攻击，并区分“目标侧成本”与“攻击者侧成本”。
- **方法衔接**：基于 Fair-ASR 识别出已有攻击在目标调用与攻击者调用上的效率差距，作者引入 ReCode——一种组合式、预算高效的攻击。ReCode 结合了脱敏重写（desensitization rewriting）与两种由 Fair-ASR 确认的低代价原语（primitive）。
- **输出**：各攻击在不同目标调用预算下的排名，以及它们在目标调用和攻击者调用两个维度上的效率表现。摘要未说明 Fair-ASR 的具体协议步骤（如预算取值、重放规则），也未说明 ReCode 中两种原语的具体实现。

# 主要结果

在 Fair-ASR 协议下，11 种攻击的排名在不同目标调用预算之间发生了明显变化；简单的随机扰动和手工模板在相同目标访问条件下仍然非常有竞争力。被评估的 LLM 驱动方法中，没有任何一种在目标调用和攻击者调用上同时高效。相比之下，ReCode 在 20 次目标调用预算下，在 GPT-5 上达到 85% 的 ASR，平均每次请求仅需 7.19 次攻击者调用，在两类调用上均表现出很强的效率。

# 为什么与兴趣相关

对 LLM 安全评估与越狱防御而言，公平比较攻击方法是前提。Fair-ASR 提供了一个更贴近黑盒实际约束的评估方式；ReCode 则展示了在有限目标预算下仍能保持高成功率的攻击设计，有助于理解越狱攻击的效率来源与风险边界。

papers.title: Q-Interference: Memory-Efficient Phase-Aware Quantum-Inspired Attention
papers.abstract: GPT attention measures token compatibility through dot-product similarity. This mechanism is simple, effective, and memory-efficient. But it does not explicitly model whether strong token features should reinforce or suppress one another. We introduce Q-Interference, a fully classical quantum-inspired attention mechanism for autoregressive language modeling that augments each query and key feature with an amplitude and a learned phase. The resulting attention score is phase-aware which aligned phases contribute constructively while conflicting phases contribute destructively. Although Q-Interference yields a richer interaction rule than similarity alone, a naive implementation of Q-Interference requires a large token-pair-feature interaction tensor, making it memory-intensive and often impractical. To address this limitation, we propose an exact trigonometric factorization that computes the same score using two standard matrix multiplications avoiding materialization of the large intermediate tensor. Q-Interference fits directly into a Transformer block in GPT and leaves the remainder of the model architecture and next-token prediction objective unchanged. Experiments on public benchmark datasets and baseline models show that the proposed reformulation trains stably in a controlled GPT-style setting and provides a consistent memory advantage over naive phase-aware interference attention. These results support the specific contribution of this work: an exact memory-efficient reformulation that makes phase-aware interference attention practical within a standard GPT pipeline.

papers.title_zh: Q-Interference：内存高效的相位感知量子启发注意力
papers.abstract_zh: GPT注意力通过点积相似度衡量token兼容性。该机制简单、有效且内存高效。但它并未显式建模强token特征之间应当相互增强还是相互抑制。我们引入了Q-Interference，一种用于自回归语言建模的完全经典的量子启发的注意力机制，它为每个查询和键特征附加一个振幅和一个学习到的相位。由此产生的注意力分数具有相位感知性，对齐的相位产生建设性贡献，而冲突的相位产生破坏性贡献。尽管Q-Interference产生了比单纯相似性更丰富的交互规则，但Q-Interference的朴素实现需要大型token对特征交互张量，使其内存密集且往往不切实际。为解决这一限制，我们提出了一种精确的三角分解，通过两次标准矩阵乘法计算相同分数，避免物化大型中间张量。Q-Interference直接适配GPT中的Transformer块，并保持模型架构其余部分和下一token预测目标不变。在公开基准数据集和基线模型上的实验表明，所提出的重构在受控GPT风格设置中能够稳定训练，并且相比朴素相位感知干扰注意力提供了一致的内存优势。这些结果支持了本工作的具体贡献：一种精确的、内存高效的重构，使相位感知干扰注意力在标准GPT流程中变得实用。

papers.title: ADAPTD: Adaptive Detection and Proactive Threat Defense for Autonomous APT attacks
papers.abstract: Advanced persistent threat (APT) actors increasingly employ sophisticated techniques to propagate laterally through segmented enterprise networks. Timely detection and defense depend on cross-subnetwork coordination, yet maintaining global situational awareness generates substantial communication overhead. To manage this tradeoff, flexible monitoring and adaptable containment are imperative. This paper presents ADAPTD, a communication- and computation-efficient, decision-theoretic framework integrating: (i) compact kill chains for identifying diverse attack vectors, (ii) an immediate blocking mechanism for timely containment, and (iii) a predictive eviction strategy to restore system security. Our experiments validate ADAPTD's effectiveness across diverse threat scenarios. First, our decentralized belief update scheme outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion HMM. Second, ADAPTD substantially reduces false evictions compared to transformer-based detection. Third, under noisy environments, adaptive blocking contains attackers while minimizing unnecessary disruption. Lastly, the ablation study confirms that combining two defensive actions significantly reduces the defender's total cost.

papers.title: Explicit State Elicitation Is Not Enough: A Controlled Audit of Memory-Policy Classification
papers.abstract: Personalized agents must decide whether retrieved user memory should be used, ignored, updated, or queried before it affects a current task. We use this setting to develop an empirical audit protocol for structured intermediate outputs: first audit dataset shortcuts, then isolate bundled prompt changes, check whether intermediate labels are answer-associated, test decomposed semantic evidence, and audit provider-level execution failures. A 480-example synthetic development set initially suggested large gains from a state-structured prompt bundle, but TF-IDF diagnostics showed lexical separability and no positive standalone Ignore cases. We therefore construct a frozen 160-example controlled counterfactual set with 40 matched four-way families and rule-derived reference policies. On this set, exposing the four state definitions improves accuracy, but an isolated explicit state-output field does not significantly improve policy accuracy for Llama-3.3-70B and gives only a marginal, non-significant gain for GPT-OSS-120B. Supplying benchmark-associated state labels shifts policy predictions, but because those labels deterministically map to policies, this is a label-conditioning diagnostic rather than evidence of a faithful internal mechanism. Family-level and seed-stability analyses further show that example-level accuracy overstates counterfactual consistency: complete four-way family success is rare. An exploratory follow-up that elicits decomposed semantic evidence also fails to improve routing for the cleanly evaluated endpoint; the corresponding GPT-OSS condition was unavailable because of provider-side request validation. We evaluate policy classification only, not downstream responses, tool actions, or memory-store mutation.

papers.title_zh: 显式状态引出并不足够：记忆策略分类的受控审计
papers.abstract_zh: 个性化智能体必须决定检索到的用户记忆在被用于当前任务之前，是否应被使用、忽略、更新或查询。我们利用这一场景为结构化中间输出开发了一种经验性审计协议：首先审计数据集捷径，然后隔离捆绑的提示变化，检查中间标签是否与答案相关，测试分解后的语义证据，并审计提供方层面的执行失败。一个包含480个示例的合成开发集最初表明，状态结构化提示捆绑带来了巨大收益，但TF-IDF诊断显示存在词汇可分性，且没有正的独立忽略案例。因此，我们构建了一个固定的160示例受控反事实集，包含40个匹配的四路族和规则推导的参考策略。在该集合上，暴露四种状态定义提高了准确性，但对于Llama-3.3-70B，一个孤立的显式状态输出字段并未显著提高策略准确性，对GPT-OSS-120B仅带来边际性的、不显著的提升。提供与基准关联的状态标签会改变策略预测，但由于这些标签确定性地映射到策略，这是一种标签条件诊断，而非忠实内部机制的证据。族级和种子稳定性分析进一步表明，示例级准确性夸大了反事实一致性：完整的四路族成功是罕见的。一项探索性的后续研究引出分解后的语义证据也未能改善干净评估端点的路由；相应的GPT-OSS条件因提供方侧请求验证而不可用。我们仅评估策略分类，不评估下游响应、工具操作或记忆存储变更。

papers.title: On Post-Quantum Multi-Key Security of GCM
papers.abstract: This paper studies the post-quantum multi-key security of Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) in the Quantum Ideal Cipher Model (QICM). GCM is one of the most widely deployed AEAD schemes. In practice, widely deployed cryptosystems are often instantiated under many independent keys, making the multi-key setting practically relevant. A trivial extension of a single-key security bound to the multi-key setting incurs a security loss proportional to the number of keys. In particular, in the post-quantum setting, the term corresponding to exhaustive key search becomes $up^2/2^k$, where $u$ is the number of keys and $k$ is the key length. Here, $u$ is the number of keys, $k$ is the key length, and $p$ is the number of quantum queries to the underlying block cipher $E$ and its inverse, which serves as a coarse measure of the amount of offline (quantum) computation performed by the adversary. For example, when $u=2^{32}$, the trivial bound does not guarantee security for $p \geq 2^{48}$ when $k=128$, and even for $k=192$, it ceases to guarantee security for $p \geq 2^{80}$. We show that, at the cost of some additional loss terms, the term $up^2/2^k$ can be replaced by a term of order $\sqrt{dp^2/2^k}$, where $d$ denotes the maximum number of keys under which the same nonce appears in encryption queries. Thus, when $d$ is much smaller than $u$ (and the additional loss terms remain small), our bound improves upon the trivial multi-key bound. This can be viewed as a post-quantum counterpart of the classical result of Hoang et al. (CCS 2018). As in their work, we further show that, for randomized nonce-generation mechanisms that abstract patterns used in protocols such as TLS, the parameter $d$ remains small even when $u$ is large. Although our bounds are not tight and leave room for improvement, they yield a notable improvement over the trivial multi-key bound for several concrete parameter settings. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first non-trivial post-quantum multi-key security bound for an AEAD mode in the QICM. Our proof combines the reprogramming-and-resampling approach of Alagic et al. (EUROCRYPT 2022) with counting arguments used in the classical multi-user analysis of GCM by Hoang et al.

papers.title: Which Source Wins? Task-Dependent Reliance in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) combine images and text, but when the two conflict and one becomes harder to read, it is unclear how a model shifts its reliance between them. We study this modality reallocation with a controlled setup: we degrade either the image or the text across four levels of legibility while keeping the other clean, and track how the model's preference changes. We build conflicts from GSM8K and SVAMP by pairing the rendered image of one arithmetic problem with the text of another, so the two sources support different answers. We also introduce ChartQA-Conflict, a manually reviewed benchmark of 229 chart-report conflicts with matched chart and table-image representations. We evaluate six open-weight VLMs using both generated answers and a length-normalized conditional log-likelihood margin. On GSM8K and SVAMP, five of six models shift more strongly away from degraded text than from degraded images. On ChartQA-Conflict, all six likelihood-scored models exhibit the opposite pattern, shifting more strongly away from the degraded visual source. This reversal persists after calibrating for unimodal accuracy loss and after replacing charts with plain table images. Two frontier API models, GPT-5.6-Luna and Gemini-3.5-Flash, behaviorally replicate the ChartQA-Conflict reversal, with GPT-5.6-Luna also matching the arithmetic direction. These results show that modality reliance in VLMs is not fixed, but varies across tasks, evidence structures, models, and evaluation settings. The source code is available at https://github.com/Ro-netizen004/multimodal-arbitration-artifact.

papers.title_zh: 哪个来源胜出？视觉语言模型中的任务相关依赖
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）结合图像和文本，但当两者冲突且其中一个变得更难辨认时，模型如何在两者之间转移其依赖尚不清楚。我们通过一个受控设置研究这种模态重新分配：我们将图像或文本中的一方在四个可读性级别上降低可读性，同时保持另一方清晰，并跟踪模型的偏好如何变化。我们通过将一道算术问题的渲染图像与另一道算术问题的文本配对来构建来自 GSM8K 和 SVAMP 的冲突，从而使两个来源支持不同的答案。我们还引入了 ChartQA-Conflict，这是一个经过人工审核的基准，包含 229 个图表-报告冲突，并具有匹配的图表和表格图像表示。我们使用生成的答案和长度归一化的条件对数似然边际评估了六个开放权重 VLM。在 GSM8K 和 SVAMP 上，六个模型中有五个在远离退化文本的转移程度上强于远离退化图像的转移程度。在 ChartQA-Conflict 上，所有六个基于似然评分的模型都表现出相反的pattern，即更强烈地远离退化的视觉来源。这种逆转在针对单模态准确率损失进行校准后以及将图表替换为纯表格图像后仍然存在。两个前沿 API 模型 GPT-5.6-Luna 和 Gemini-3.5-Flash 在行为上复现了 ChartQA-Conflict 的逆转，其中 GPT-5.6-Luna 也匹配了算术任务的方向。这些结果表明，VLM 中的模态依赖不是固定的，而是随任务、证据结构、模型和评估设置而变化。源代码可在 https://github.com/Ro-netizen004/multimodal-arbitration-artifact 获取。

papers.title: Synthesizing Feature Extractors: An Agentic Approach for Algorithm Selection
papers.abstract: Algorithm selection for constraint satisfaction problems requires extracting features that capture problem structure. Manually designing feature extractors demands deep domain expertise and quickly becomes a bottleneck when new problem classes appear. We present an automated approach that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) in an agentic check--fix--verify loop to synthesize executable Python scripts that act as interpretable, problem-specific feature extractors. Given a high-level MiniZinc model and an instance, the LLM agent generates code that constructs a typed graph representation and computes structural properties such as graph density, variable clustering, and constraint tightness. We evaluate our approach on three combinatorial problems (vehicle routing, car sequencing, fixed-length error-correcting codes) with a portfolio of five state-of-the-art solvers. The synthesized extractors yield algorithm selectors that consistently outperform both expert-curated mzn2feat features (up to $8.3$ percentage points (pp) test-set accuracy on FLECC) and the best transformer-based trans2feat variants. In the meanwhile, the synthesized feature extractors remain inspectable.

papers.title_zh: 合成特征提取器：一种用于算法选择的智能体方法
papers.abstract_zh: 约束满足问题的算法选择需要提取能够捕获问题结构的特征。手动设计特征提取器需要深厚的领域专业知识，并且当新的问题类别出现时会迅速成为瓶颈。我们提出了一种自动化方法，在智能体式的“检查-修复-验证”循环中使用大语言模型（LLMs）来合成可执行的Python脚本，这些脚本可作为可解释的、面向特定问题的特征提取器。给定一个高层MiniZinc模型和一个实例，LLM智能体生成代码，构建一个类型化图表示，并计算结构属性，如图密度、变量聚类和约束紧密度。我们使用一个由五个最先进求解器组成的求解器组合，在三个组合问题上评估了我们的方法：车辆路径规划、汽车排序、定长纠错码。合成的特征提取器所得到的算法选择器持续优于专家精心设计的mzn2feat特征（在FLECC上测试集准确率最高提升8.3个百分点（pp））以及最好的基于transformer的trans2feat变体。与此同时，合成的特征提取器仍然保持可检查性。

papers.title: Can LLMs Reason in a Legally Meaningful Manner? A Small-scale Study on European Court of Human Rights Cases
papers.abstract: Reasoning has become a standard technique and feature for contemporary LLMs; however, its application and quality in the context of demanding legal-oriented tasks, such as legal case forecasting, remain under explored. We investigate how LLMs reason in the context of legal case forecasting, using legal cases from the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) as a testbed. We evaluate OpenAI GPT 5.4, a recent top-tier LLM, by exploring alternative prompting strategies that are more or less suggestive of what counts as legally meaningful reasoning in the context of ECtHR jurisprudence. We present our findings derived from assessing the model's responses with both human and LLM evaluation. We find that the examined model scores far from ideal in legal reasoning, the model produces structurally complete but substantively shallow analyses, and that LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators are internally consistent yet align only weakly with our trained annotators, i.e., reliable but not a valid substitute for human evaluation. Overall, the expert-curated prompt leads to more comprehensive reasoning, which does not result in more accurate predictions compared to the other examined settings. Based on our findings, we urge the community not to rely solely on automated LLM-based evaluation and to avoid using task accuracy as an appropriate proxy for reasoning quality.

papers.title_zh: LLM能否以具有法律意义的方式进行推理？欧洲人权法院案件的小规模研究
papers.abstract_zh: 推理已成为当代LLM的标准技术和特性；然而，在具有高要求的法律导向任务（如法律案件预测）中，推理的应用和质量仍然探索不足。我们以欧洲人权法院（ECtHR）的法律案件为测试平台，研究了LLM在法律案件预测背景下的推理方式。我们通过探索不同的提示策略来评估近期顶级LLM OpenAI GPT 5.4，这些策略在不同程度上提示了在ECtHR判例背景下什么构成具有法律意义的推理。我们展示了通过人工评估和LLM评估对模型回应进行评估后得出的发现。我们发现，所评测的模型在法律推理方面远未达到理想水平，模型产生的分析结构完整但内容浅薄，且LLM-as-a-Judge评估器内部一致，但与我们的受训标注员仅存在微弱对齐，即可靠但并非人工评估的有效替代。总体而言，专家精心设计的提示带来了更全面的推理，但与其他测试设置相比，并未带来更准确的预测。基于我们的发现，我们敦促社区不要仅依赖基于LLM的自动化评估，并避免将任务准确率用作推理质量的适当代理指标。

papers.title: SCENARIODIFF: A Scenario-level Guidance Framework for Multimodal Time Series Forecasting--Extended Version
papers.abstract: Textual context such as news, reports, and logs can provide valuable signals for time series forecasting, especially when future dynamics are driven by external events that are not yet visible in historical values. Existing multimodal forecasting methods often either ask large language models (LLMs) to predict numerical values directly or fuse text and time series implicitly, making contextual influence difficult to interpret and control. We propose SCENARIODIFF, a hierarchical contextual reasoning framework for multimodal time series forecasting under noisy and weakly aligned documents. SCENARIODIFF organizes contextual information into three levels: a Historical Context Agent extracts stepwise evidence from raw documents, a Scenario Agent produces a qualitative scenario description for the forecast horizon, and an Anchor Guidance Agent generates sparse anchor points for event-relevant future regions. These structured signals condition a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer, while Anchor Blended Sampling locally refines generated trajectories without retraining. Experiments on the Time-MMD benchmark show that SCENARIODIFF is especially effective in event-driven domains, demonstrating the value of explicit hierarchical scenario guidance for multimodal time series forecasting. Our full implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ScenarioDiff_ICDM-2C4C

papers.abstract_zh: 新闻、报告和日志等文本上下文可以为时间序列预测提供有价值的信号，尤其是当未来动态由历史值中尚未显现的外部事件驱动时。现有的多模态预测方法要么让大型语言模型（LLM）直接预测数值，要么隐式融合文本和时间序列，使得上下文影响难以解释和控制。我们提出SCENARIODIFF，一种用于在噪声和弱对齐文档下进行多模态时间序列预测的分层上下文推理框架。SCENARIODIFF将上下文信息组织为三个层级：历史上下文代理从原始文档中提取逐步证据，场景代理为预测时段生成定性场景描述，锚点引导代理为事件相关的未来区域生成稀疏锚点。这些结构化信号条件化一个多模态扩散Transformer，同时锚点混合采样无需重新训练即可局部细化生成的轨迹。在Time-MMD基准上的实验表明，SCENARIODIFF在事件驱动领域尤为有效，展示了显式分层场景引导对多模态时间序列预测的价值。我们的完整实现可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ScenarioDiff_ICDM-2C4C获取。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Cross-Border Electricity Price Forecasting: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract: While publicly available electricity market data presents a valuable resource for forecasting research, the field lacks established benchmark datasets for standardized comparison. As a result, many studies have relied on different datasets and metrics to evaluate methods in isolated settings, making it difficult to assess progress and compare state-of-the-art approaches consistently. In this work, we use public data to evaluate deep learning models for electricity price forecasting (EPF) across multiple market settings. Our goal is to establish a reproducible framework that enables a consistent evaluation of forecasting models. Although deep learning has been explored for day-ahead EPF, many prior studies are limited to single-market settings, narrow feature sets, or fixed training regimes. This work presents a comparative evaluation of six deep learning models--covering state-space, MLP, RNN, and Transformer-based architectures--emphasizing generalization across markets. We simulate low-data target-market conditions using zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot learning. Our test set focuses on the Germany-Luxembourg (DE-LU) bidding zone in 2024 using a standardized dataset with calendar, historical price, and market-derived features. Our findings suggest that N-HiTS and NBEATSx perform competitively in limited-data scenarios, while transformer-based models can reach comparable accuracy but tend to require more adaptation and tuning. Model performance also benefits from careful feature selection and hyperparameter tuning, and we note that the differences between the strongest models are often small.

papers.title_zh: 深度学习在跨境电价预测中的应用：一项比较研究
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管公开可用的电力市场数据为预测研究提供了宝贵的资源，但该领域缺乏用于标准化比较的既定基准数据集。因此，许多研究依赖不同的数据集和指标在孤立的环境中评估方法，这使得难以一致地评估进展和比较最先进的方法。在本工作中，我们使用公开数据评估深度学习模型在多种市场环境下的电价预测（EPF）。我们的目标是建立一个可复现的框架，使得对预测模型进行一致的评估成为可能。尽管深度学习已被探索用于日前电价预测，但许多先前的研究局限于单一市场环境、狭窄的特征集或固定的训练机制。本研究对六种深度学习模型——涵盖状态空间、MLP、RNN和基于Transformer的架构——进行了比较评估，强调跨市场的泛化能力。我们使用零样本、单样本和少样本学习来模拟低数据目标市场条件。我们的测试集聚焦于2024年德国-卢森堡（DE-LU）竞价区，使用包含日历、历史价格和市场衍生特征的标准化数据集。我们的研究结果表明，N-HiTS和NBEATSx在有限数据场景下表现出竞争力，而基于Transformer的模型可以达到相当的准确性，但往往需要更多的适配和调参。模型性能还受益于仔细的特征选择和超参数调整，我们注意到最强模型之间的差异通常很小。

papers.title: Foundation Agents Meet Agentic Deep Research: Evidence-Grounded Clinical Code Forecasting
papers.abstract: Next-encounter ICD forecasting predicts which standardized diagnosis codes will be documented at a future visit from the longitudinal record available beforehand. The task is prospective and multi-label: the target note does not yet exist, and several codes may be correct. Structured EHR foundation models capture recurrence and temporal progression, whereas language foundation models generate flexible diagnostic hypotheses. We introduce ICD-Deepresearch, a DeepResearch workflow that composes these predictive foundation models with medical search and ICD dictionaries. Because no source reveals the future code set, research evaluates candidate transitions by linking patient evidence, external clinical relations, and exact code semantics under a fixed top-K budget. Candidate Generation uses SparseEHR to produce an EHR Prior that initializes two bounded Research Expansion rounds; an independent GPT-5 Direct Forecast supplies complementary candidates. Final Selection validates, deduplicates, and jointly ranks both paths, after which a separate module writes rationales without changing predictions. Finally ICD-Deepresearch achieves patient-averaged precision/recall of 24.60/35.09% on MIMIC-III and 25.14/48.32% on MIMIC-IV. Physicians rate 51% and 68% of its retrieved documents useful, compared with 22% and 39% for standalone GPT-5 web search and 32% and 41% for Medical Deep Research. ICD-Deepresearch therefore improves over the registered local comparators while retrieving evidence with higher physician-rated usefulness than the standalone research systems

papers.title_zh: 基础智能体遇见智能体深度研究：基于证据的临床代码预测
papers.abstract_zh: 下一次就诊ICD预测从事先可获得的纵向记录中，预测未来就诊时将记录的标准化诊断代码。该任务是前瞻性和多标签的：目标记录尚不存在，且可能有多个代码是正确的。结构化EHR基础模型捕捉复发和时间进展，而语言基础模型生成灵活的诊断假设。我们引入了ICD-Deepresearch，一种DeepResearch工作流，它将这些预测性基础模型与医学搜索和ICD词典组合在一起。由于没有来源能揭示未来的代码集，研究在固定的top-K预算下，通过将患者证据、外部临床关系和精确代码语义联系起来，评估候选转换。候选生成使用SparseEHR产生一个EHR先验，该先验初始化两轮有界研究扩展；一个独立的GPT-5直接预测提供补充候选。最终选择对两条路径进行验证、去重和联合排序，之后一个单独的模块在不改变预测的情况下撰写理由。最后，ICD-Deepresearch在MIMIC-III上实现了患者平均精确率/召回率24.60/35.09%，在MIMIC-IV上实现了25.14/48.32%。医生对其检索文档的有用性评价为51%和68%，而独立GPT-5网络搜索为22%和39%，医学深度研究为32%和41%。因此，ICD-Deepresearch相对于注册的本地比较器有所改进，同时检索到的证据在医生评定的有用性方面高于独立研究系统。

papers.title: Verifiable Compression of Images
papers.abstract: AI image generation has made image misinformation a serious concern. To address this issue, the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) standard adopts digital signatures to attest that an image originates from an authorized source, such as an attested camera or authorized AI provider. In practice, however, raw images are rarely published directly: photos are typically compressed before publication, which invalidates any C2PA signature. Recent works have proposed the use of zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) to prove that only allowed edits were applied to a C2PA-signed original image. Unfortunately, prior works only support simple edits (e.g. cropping, blurring, and resizing) and do not support lossy image compression like JPEG, which is ubiquitous. The purpose of compression is to save communication. Therefore, unlike other edits, it cannot be verified directly, requires small proof sizes, and is unsuitable to outsourcing. To address these limitations, we present SPEG, the first practical proof system that supports the full image-transmission pipeline on personal devices. We present two protocols that support JPEG compression, while proving validity of the C2PA signature on the original image. The two modes are incomparable: the first is compatible with an arbitrary hashing algorithm (we use Poseidon for efficiency), whereas the second is significantly faster but requires the C2PA to use a polynomial commitment (e.g., KZH) instead of a conventional hash. Our key optimizations are handling the non-algebraic JPEG Encoding outside the proving circuit, and avoiding range checks in our floating-point arithmetic. We can prove the JPEG compression of an FHD(1080p) image in 47s in the Poseidon mode and in 2s in the fast mode. The fastest prior work (VerITAS) which only handles simple resizing, requires 227s on the same consumer hardware. Additionally, we identify a security gap in VIMz (PETS 25) that enables forgery of proofs for unauthorized images and provide a fix. We also prove that we can securely use the popular powers-of-tau SRS with the polynomial commitment scheme KZH.

papers.title: Silent Threshold Encryption from Lattices
papers.abstract: Silent threshold encryption is a generalization of threshold encryption where the public encryption key associated with a group of users is a deterministic function of their individual public keys. The main efficiency requirement is that the ciphertext size should be sublinear in (and ideally, independent of) the size of the decryption quorum $N$. Existing constructions of silent threshold encryption for arbitrary threshold policies have either relied on bilinear maps or on heavyweight tools such as witness encryption and indistinguishability obfuscation. Recently, several works have shown how to support constant thresholds from the decomposed learning with errors (LWE) problem. In this work, we show how to construct a silent threshold encryption scheme from the decomposed LWE assumption where the ciphertext size for encrypting a single bit is $\tilde{O}(T) + \mathsf{poly}(\lambda, \log N)$. Here, $N$ is the total number of users, $T$ is the threshold, and $\lambda$ is the security parameter. Our scheme achieves non-trivial succinctness for all thresholds $T = N^\varepsilon$ for any constant $\varepsilon < 1$. More generally, our scheme extends beyond threshold policies to any monotone policy family that has a succinct (computational) secret sharing scheme; the ciphertext in this case scales with the maximum number of corrupted shares. The core building block in our work is a new bounded-collusion registered functional encryption (FE) scheme with succinct ciphertexts. Specifically, for $N$ users and a collusion bound $Q$, we obtain a registered FE scheme that supports depth-$d$ Boolean circuits on $\ell$-bit inputs and single-bit output with ciphertext size $Q \cdot \tilde{O}(d) + \ell \cdot \mathsf{poly}(\lambda, d, \log N)$. Security relies on the decomposed LWE assumption in the random oracle model. Previously, bounded-collusion registered FE for general circuits was known only from bilinear maps, evasive LWE, or indistinguishability obfuscation.

papers.relevance_reason_zh: 论文提出格上静默阈值加密和注册功能加密，属于密码学隐私计算协议，但不涉及保护模型推理。
papers.summary_zh:
### 一句话结论
本文基于格上的 decomposed LWE（分解的带噪学习误差）假设，构造了一种静默阈值加密方案，其密文大小可以做到亚线性于用户总数，并将该构建推广到更一般的单调策略族。

### 问题与动机
静默阈值加密（silent threshold encryption）是传统阈值加密的推广。特点是：与用户组关联的公共加密密钥是各用户个体公钥的确定性函数，因此无需中心化密钥聚合过程；其主要效率要求是密文大小应亚线性于解密法定人数 \(N\)，理想情况下与 \(N\) 无关。此前构造任意阈值策略的静默阈值加密，要么依赖双线性映射，要么使用 witness encryption（见证加密）和 indistinguishability obfuscation（不可区分混淆）等重量级工具。近期工作虽能从 decomposed LWE 支持常数阈值，但任意阈值的简洁构造仍是一个开放问题。

### 方法与技术路线
该工作的核心构建模块是一个 **有界共谋注册功能加密**（bounded-collusion registered functional encryption，简称 registered FE）方案。注册功能加密允许用户自行注册公钥，加密者使用由这些公钥派生的公共参数加密，而解密者持有与自身属性相关的功能密钥。本方案在 \(N\) 个用户、共谋界限为 \(Q\) 的设置下，支持深度为 \(d\) 的布尔电路，接受 \(\ell\) 位输入，输出单比特；其密文大小为  
\[
Q \cdot \tilde{O}(d) + \ell \cdot \mathsf{poly}(\lambda, d, \log N),
\]
其中 \(\lambda\) 为安全参数。该 FE 方案的安全性基于随机预言机模型下的 decomposed LWE 假设；摘要未披露底格维度、噪声分布等具体参数。

作者将上述注册 FE 作为核心积木，构造了静默阈值加密：加密单个比特时，密文大小变为  
\[
\tilde{O}(T) + \mathsf{poly}(\lambda, \log N),
\]  
其中 \(T\) 是阈值。这一简洁性来自 FE 的密文结构——阈值策略被编码为布尔电路，而注册 FE 的注册特性恰好对应静默阈值加密中“公钥为用户公钥确定性函数”的要求。进一步地，该方案可超越阈值策略，推广到任何具有简洁（计算性）秘密共享方案的单调策略族，此时密文大小与最大被损坏共享数成正比。摘要未说明从 FE 到静默阈值加密的具体归约步骤，也未涉及任何实验数据。

### 主要结果
- 首次从 decomposed LWE 假设构造了任意阈值的静默阈值加密，密文大小 \(\tilde{O}(T)+\mathsf{poly}(\lambda,\log N)\)。
- 对任意常数 \(\varepsilon<1\) 的阈值 \(T=N^\varepsilon\)，方案实现非平凡的密文简洁性。
- 有界共谋注册 FE 支持通用布尔电路，密文尺寸为 \(Q\cdot \tilde{O}(d)+\ell\cdot\mathsf{poly}(\lambda,d,\log N)\)。
- 此前同类 FE 方案只能依赖双线性映射、evasive LWE 或不可区分混淆，而本方案基于更标准的格上假设。

### 为什么与兴趣相关
该工作把静默阈值加密的底层假设从重量级混淆/见证加密推进到格上的 decomposed LWE，显著降低了构造的复杂度门槛，同时保留了亚线性密文的效率优势。注册 FE 作为中间原语，本身也可能在其他联邦或分布式密码协议中找到用途。对于关注隐私计算、后量子密码和功能加密的研究者，这是一个值得关注的进展；但它不涉及保护模型推理，因此与机器学习推理场景无直接关联。

- 有界共谋注册 FE 支持通用布尔电路，密文尺寸为 \(Q\cdot \tilde{O}(d)+\ell\cdot\mathsf{poly}(\lambda,d,\log N)\)。
- 此前同类 FE 方案只能依赖双线性映射、evasive LWE 或不可区分混淆，而本方案基于更标准的格上假设。

### 为什么与兴趣相关
该工作把静默阈值加密的底层假设从重量级混淆/见证加密推进到格上的 decomposed LWE，显著降低了构造的复杂度门槛，同时保留了亚线性密文的效率优势。注册 FE 作为中间原语，本身也可能在其他联邦或分布式密码协议中找到用途。对于关注隐私计算、后量子密码和功能加密的研究者，这是一个值得关注的进展；但它不涉及保护模型推理，因此与机器学习推理场景无直接关联。

papers.title: PXDepth: Pixel-Space Modeling for Structure Preserving Monocular Depth Estimation
papers.abstract: Recent monocular depth estimators achieve strong zero-shot generalization, yet often struggle to preserve fine-grained structures and object boundaries. We attribute this limitation to the prevalent combination of large-patch ViT encoders and convolutional decoders, as coarse tokenization can weaken pixel-level cues that upsampling cannot fully recover. To address this issue, we propose PXDepth, a discriminative monocular depth model that separates global context modeling from pixel-level depth prediction. Specifically, a large-patch ViT captures global scene context, while a pixel-space predictor composed of Context-Modulated Pixel Transformer blocks maintains high-resolution spatial representations throughout depth estimation. This design preserves fine structures and sharp boundaries without sacrificing global depth consistency. Across diverse zero-shot benchmarks, PXDepth combines faithful local geometry with competitive global depth accuracy while remaining efficient at inference. Our code and model are available at https://yuanzhy29.github.io/PXDepth-Page/.

papers.title_zh: PXDepth：面向结构保持的单目深度估计的像素空间建模
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的单目深度估计器实现了强大的零样本泛化能力，但通常在保持细粒度结构和物体边界方面存在困难。我们将这一局限性归因于大块ViT编码器与卷积解码器的普遍组合，因为粗糙的令牌化会削弱像素级线索，而上采样无法完全恢复这些线索。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PXDepth，一种判别式单目深度模型，将全局上下文建模与像素级深度预测分离。具体而言，大块ViT捕获全局场景上下文，而由上下文调制像素Transformer块组成的像素空间预测器在整个深度估计过程中保持高分辨率空间表示。这种设计在保持全局深度一致性的同时，保留了精细结构和清晰边界。在各种零样本基准测试中，PXDepth将忠实的局部几何与有竞争力的全局深度精度相结合，同时在推理时保持高效。我们的代码和模型可在https://yuanzhy29.github.io/PXDepth-Page/获取。

papers.title: Towards Computational Provenance: Carrying Causal-State Evidence in Generated Text
papers.abstract: A language model's output does not by itself provide verifiable evidence about the internal computation that produced it. We study computational provenance: whether generated text can carry detectable evidence of which causally relevant internal state occurred. We test a bounded form of this idea in two controlled architectures: a modular feed-forward neural network and a transformer-based model. Both architectures are trained on the same arithmetic task with a mandatory pathway through two discrete intermediate states, allowing different internal paths to produce the same answer. We deliberately switch between these paths, authenticate the state actually used, and let that verified state determine a subtle statistical pattern in the generated text that can later be detected. The feed-forward and transformer systems each passed all 128 matched pairs in both their public and separately sealed protected end-to-end evaluations, with the detector recovering the signal associated with the authenticated internal state. The required causal computation also reproduced across five independently trained feed-forward models and three independently trained transformers. In a separate answer-only transformer experiment, our linear probes did not recover a naturally learned intermediate state. These results provide a controlled proof of concept that information about a verified, causally relevant internal state can be preserved in generated text even when the answer is unchanged.

papers.title_zh: 迈向计算溯源：在生成文本中携带因果状态证据
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型的输出本身并不提供关于产生该输出的内部计算的可验证证据。我们研究计算溯源：生成文本是否能携带关于哪个因果相关内部状态发生的可检测证据。我们在两种受控架构中测试了这一思想的有限形式：一个模块化前馈神经网络和一个基于Transformer的模型。这两种架构都在同一个算术任务上训练，该任务具有通过两个离散中间状态的必经路径，从而允许不同的内部路径产生相同的答案。我们故意在这些路径之间切换，验证实际使用的状态，并让该已验证状态决定生成文本中一个可被后续检测的细微统计模式。前馈和Transformer系统在公开评估和单独密封的受保护端到端评估中均通过了全部128个匹配对，检测器恢复了与已验证内部状态相关的信号。所需的因果计算也在五个独立训练的前馈模型和三个独立训练的Transformer中复现。在另一个仅答案的Transformer实验中，我们的线性探针未能恢复自然学习到的中间状态。这些结果提供了一个受控的概念验证：即使答案不变，关于已验证的、因果相关的内部状态的信息也能保留在生成文本中。

papers.title: Non-Crossing Deep Quantile Regression for Distributional Survival Prediction
papers.abstract: In survival analysis the way covariates act on the risk of an event often differs between early and late failure times, yet hazard- and mean-based summaries collapse this variation into a single number. Quantile-based modeling instead describes the full conditional distribution on the original time scale, but existing censored-data methods are either inflexible or produce logically inconsistent crossing quantile curves. We propose a Censored Non-crossing Quantile (CNQ) framework for right-censored data that jointly estimates several conditional survival quantiles and guarantees valid ordering by construction, with flexibility supplied by Kolmogorov-Arnold and Transformer backbones, and we establish a finite-sample excess-risk bound holding jointly across all fitted quantile levels. Across 27 simulation settings and six cohorts the framework attains lower pinball loss than quantile-, hazard- and tree-based competitors whenever the conditional distribution is asymmetric, with interval coverage closer to nominal on all six. In two clinical case studies (METABRIC, breast cancer; FLCHAIN, population mortality) it recovers covariate effects that vary across the survival distribution and would be hidden by a single hazard ratio, and yields coherent individualized quantile milestones. Code: https://github.com/BIG-S2/deepcnq

papers.title_zh: 非交叉深度分位数回归用于分布生存预测
papers.abstract_zh: 在生存分析中，协变量对事件风险的作用方式在早期和晚期失效时间之间往往不同，然而基于风险和均值的汇总将这种变化压缩为单一数值。基于分位数的建模则在原始时间尺度上描述完整的条件分布，但现有的删失数据方法要么不灵活，要么产生逻辑上不一致的交叉分位数曲线。我们提出了一种适用于右删失数据的删失非交叉分位数（CNQ）框架，该框架联合估计多个条件生存分位数，并通过构造保证有效的排序，其灵活性由Kolmogorov-Arnold和Transformer骨干网络提供，并且我们建立了一个在全部拟合分位数水平上联合成立的有限样本超额风险界。在27种模拟设置和六个队列中，当条件分布不对称时，该框架的引脚损失低于基于分位数、基于风险和基于树的竞争方法，并且在所有六个队列中区间覆盖率更接近标称水平。在两个临床案例研究（METABRIC，乳腺癌；FLCHAIN，人群死亡率）中，它恢复了随生存分布变化且会被单一风险比隐藏的协变量效应，并产生一致的个体化分位数里程碑。代码：https://github.com/BIG-S2/deepcnq

papers.title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
papers.abstract: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution. Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.
